name: advance_linear_congruential_seed
description: Updates a 16-bit value held in a global as the value times 3677 plus 3, masked to 15 bits. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:148C
name: store_word_global
description: Stores the 16-bit value passed in data register D0 into a global word. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1498
name: find_free_slot_and_process
description: Searches a table of six-byte slots, starting at index three, for the first slot whose first word is zero, and reports a status code when none is free. Otherwise it applies flag processing through helper routines and stores the slot's new values, returning a status value.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:161C
name: call_and_check_status_or_fail
description: Calls a helper and returns negative one when it gives zero. Otherwise it calls a second helper and returns negative one when a status global is non-zero, or that helper's value when it is zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:165C
name: allocate_memory_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block from a linked free list, rounding the requested size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes. It takes an exact-fit block or splits a larger one, updates the free total, and returns the block, or zero when no suitable block exists.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1738
name: read_chars_until_end_marker
description: Reads bytes from a buffered input state into a destination buffer in nested loops governed by two counts, stopping early when the end marker value is seen. It returns the number of complete units read.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:17A0
name: write_byte_to_bounded_buffer
description: Counts a call and writes one byte to a buffer whose remaining space is tracked in a field. When no space remains it calls a helper instead. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:17CA
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Library code that calls one other routine and then returns, with no other work. Its pseudo-code shows only that call.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:17DE
name: format_into_bounded_buffer
description: Resets a counter, stores the buffer pointer, runs a formatting helper on the stack arguments, then makes one further call and returns the count of bytes written.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:181C
name: parse_file_mode_and_open
description: Parses a mode string containing r, w or a, with optional plus and b flags, and calls a helper to open the stream with a matching access mode. It sets up the stream fields in the structure and returns it, or zero when the mode is invalid or opening fails.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1980
name: service_flagged_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, for each entry whose flag byte has one bit set and another clear while two stored words differ, calls a helper. It then calls one more helper and returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:19CC
name: write_to_stream_and_record_error
description: Writes through a stored file handle with a library call, and when the write fails it records the error code and sets a status value of five. It returns the write result.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1A20
name: seek_stream_and_record_error
description: Seeks a stored file handle through a library call. On failure it records the error code and sets a status value of twenty-two; when the argument equals two it makes a second library call on the handle. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1A94
name: read_stream_and_record_error
description: Reads through a stored file handle with a library call, and when the read fails it records the error code and sets a status value of five. It returns the read result.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1ADC
name: open_stream_and_record_error
description: Opens a file through a library call, and when the open returns zero it records the error code, sets status value two, and returns negative one.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1B24
name: lock_or_open_file_or_record_error
description: If a lock call returns zero it attempts an open, recording the error code and setting status value two when that open also returns zero. If the lock call returns non-zero it releases the lock and returns negative one.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1B8C
name: delete_file_or_record_error
description: If a lock call returns non-zero it unlocks and deletes the named file, then attempts an open. A zero result from that open records the error code, sets status value two, and returns negative one.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1BF4
name: close_stream
description: Closes the stored file handle through a library call and returns zero. A helper is called first when a global is non-zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1C14
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values held in registers by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves, returning the result as a 32-bit value.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1C34
name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, handling signs separately, normalizing the divisor with shifts and a correction step, and returning the quotient. Negative operands are handled through helper calls.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1C66
name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using a normalized shift-and-correct method. It returns a 64-bit result with the quotient in the high longword and the remainder in the low longword.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1CF8
name: get_slot_address_or_fail
description: Returns the address of a six-byte table slot for a given index when the index is in range and the slot's first word is non-zero. Otherwise it records error code nine and returns zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1D38
name: free_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list calling a deallocation helper on each node, then clears the list head and a count field. It returns zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1D40
name: parse_command_words
description: Splits a command line into words separated by spaces, tabs or newlines, treating double-quoted text as one word and storing pointers to up to thirty-two words. It falls back to a default stream when no words are found and otherwise obtains streams through library calls.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1D5C
name: convert_integer_to_hex_string
description: Converts an unsigned number to hexadecimal characters by repeatedly taking its low four bits and looking them up in a digit table. It reverses the digits into the output string, terminates it, and returns the length.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1DB0
name: allocate_tracked_node
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec allocation call, sized by an argument plus twelve bytes, and links it into a list of tracked allocations. It returns a pointer past the header, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1E1C
name: lookup_and_run_with_status_check
description: Calls a helper to find an object and returns negative one if none is found. Otherwise it may call a helper when a flag bit is set, runs a second helper, and returns negative one when a status global is set; otherwise it returns that helper's value.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:1E6C
name: format_printf_conversion_spec
description: Parses one printf-style conversion specification after a percent sign, handling flags, width, precision and length modifiers. It formats a character, decimal, unsigned, octal, hexadecimal, pointer or string argument with padding through an output callback, returning the position after the specifier, or zero for an unknown conversion.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:21FA
name: print_format_string_loop
description: Walks a format string and passes each ordinary character to an output callback. A percent sign starts a conversion parsed by another routine, a doubled percent sign is output as a literal, and the loop returns when the string ends.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:243A
name: run_command_loop
description: Obtains a command through a helper, handles it, and repeats until a flag global becomes non-zero. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2440
name: call_structure_function_pointer
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset inside a structure whose address is passed on the stack, then returns. The called target is a library vector.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2464
name: allocate_buffer_for_stream
description: When a stream's buffer field is empty or a flag bit is set, allocates a new buffer through a helper and stores it in the stream fields. It records error code twelve and returns negative one when the allocation fails, otherwise zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:24BC
name: flush_active_slots
description: Walks the table of slots from last to first and, for each slot with a non-zero low byte that lacks a particular flag bit, calls a helper. It then calls one more helper and returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2540
name: free_memory_block_into_list
description: Returns a block to an address-sorted free list, rounding its size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes and merging it with adjacent free blocks. It returns zero on success and negative one when the size is not positive or the block overlaps a free block.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2630
name: call_and_check_status_or_fail
description: Calls a helper and returns negative one when it gives zero. Otherwise it calls a second helper and returns negative one when a status global is non-zero, or that helper's value when it is zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:266C
name: move_memory_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source to a destination, copying backward when the destination overlaps the end of the source and forward otherwise. It returns nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:268C
name: get_or_create_list_entry
description: Finds an entry in a linked list whose status word is zero, or allocates and zeroes a new 24-byte entry through a helper when none is found. It then passes the entry to another routine and returns its result, or zero when allocation fails.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:26E8
name: validate_and_clear_entry
description: Checks a flag bit in an entry and calls a helper when it is set, then calls helpers depending on a mode field and a count. It clears a word field and makes one more helper call, returning zero only when the checks succeed and negative one otherwise.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2740
name: copy_limited_text_and_run
description: Copies up to seventy-nine characters of stored text into a local buffer. It then either writes the text through an output helper and returns negative one, or passes the buffer with fixed numeric arguments to a helper that returns zero on success.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2762
name: copy_text_and_write_or_run
description: Copies a text string into a local buffer. It then either writes the text through an output call followed by a newline and returns negative one, or passes the buffer with fixed arguments to a helper that returns zero on success. The referenced text is a break-message prefix.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:27D8
name: open_intuition_and_run_helper
description: Opens a library through the exec open call, stores a text buffer pointer, and passes fixed arguments to a helper, returning zero on success or negative one on failure. The referenced text names the intuition library.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:27F0
name: run_helper_with_fixed_arguments
description: Stores a text buffer pointer in a global, then passes fixed numeric arguments and a stored handle to a helper. It returns zero when the helper reports success and negative one otherwise.
